steps.en: Get the official binary onto your PATH
steps.zh: 把官方二进制装到 PATH 上

steps.en: Point it at the recording you do not want to scrub through
steps.zh: 把命令指向那段你不想逐帧拖的录制

steps.en: Scores every moment by loudness and labels it silent or active
steps.zh: 按响度给每个时间点打分，标成静音或有效

steps.en: Cuts the silent spans, leaving a margin around speech so cuts feel natural
steps.zh: 剪掉静音段，语音前后留一点缓冲，剪口不突兀

steps.en: Writes the edited file itself — no editor window, no timeline session
steps.zh: 自己写出剪好的文件——不开编辑器窗口，不进时间轴

steps.en: When you still want to finish by hand, export the timeline instead
steps.zh: 还想手工细剪时，改成导出时间线

steps.en: Emits a timeline file the NLE imports as an editable sequence
steps.zh: 生成 Premiere、Resolve、Final Cut 等可导入的时间线

value.en: The boring first pass over a long recording — done before you open an editor
value.zh: 长素材的第一遍粗剪，在你打开编辑器之前就做完了

sources: README.md Quick start: `auto-editor path/to/your/video.mp4`; the 'dead space' / 'first pass' framing
README.md Methods for Making Automatic Cuts: `--edit audio:threshold=0.04,stream=all` is the default; labels 0 silent / 1 active
README.md Exporting to Editors: `auto-editor example.mp4 --export premiere`, plus resolve, final-cut-pro, shotcut, kdenlive, clip-sequence
auto-editor.com/installing: Method 2 recommends `brew install auto-editor`; 'The auto-editor cli is no longer being published on pip'
